newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar Diamond talked with Total, others.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar Diamond talked with Total, others.

text.p: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp said in a statement on Tuesday that it had held talks with Total SA and others in the past, but had no comment on reports that it would buy Total Petroleum (North America).

"Over the past six years Ultramar Diamond Shamrock discussed possible business arrangements with Total and other companies in the petroleum industry. The company continues to evaluate every possible strategic alliance and combination that it believes can add shareholder value," the company said.

However, a spokeswoman added that she could not comment on reports that it would buy Total Petroleum (North America) for $400 million plus $430 million in debt. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
